title: NPS granted access (Event 6272)
plain_english: This event records a successful authentication: NPS matched a policy and granted access. If users still cannot connect after a 6272, the problem is after RADIUS: the NAS did not apply the reply (VLAN missing on the switch, an attribute it does not understand), or a later step such as DHCP failed. If other diagnoses appear above this one, those are the failures in the same paste.

any: Network Policy Server granted access to a user

causes.cause: The pasted event is from a working client, not the failing one.
causes.next_check: In Event Viewer, filter the Security log for event 6273 and 6274 around the failure time, and paste one of those.

causes.cause: RADIUS accepted, but the NAS rejected the session because of a reply attribute (VLAN not present on the switch/controller, unsupported vendor attribute).
causes.next_check: Compare the network policy's Settings > RADIUS Attributes with what the NAS supports, and check the NAS's client log for the same MAC after the Accept.
